description: This file defines the 'Exception' class within the SuiteCRM\Exception namespace, which extends PHP's built-in Exception class. It supplements the base Exception with SuiteCRM-specific behavior such as a custom message prefix, additional detail information, and a designated log level.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Exception\Exception
classes.description: A custom Exception class for SuiteCRM that adds specific behaviors like prefixed messages, detailed descriptions, and custom log levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Exception with a message, code, and previous exception, prefixing the message with '[SuiteCRM]'.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns a static message indicating an unhandled exception occurred in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the log level (CRITICAL) for this exception, as per PSR-3 logging standards.
